gen-z.name: Generation Z
gen-z.tagline: Grew up with the internet in our pockets.

welcome.headline: You’re not alone.
welcome.lead: People born the same year as you are living their lives all over the world. Different lives, same year.
welcome.yearHelp: gens is open to {{generation}} ({{start}}–{{end}}) for now. Your class can't be changed later.
welcome.pickYear: Pick your birth year to find your class.
welcome.regionHelp: Only the country or region name appears on your posts. No precise location is collected.

home.belonging: Everyone born in {{year}}, wherever they are in the world, living their own day.
home.emptyTitle: Your class is quiet right now
home.emptyBody: Somewhere, someone born in {{year}} may be reading this too. A small post is enough to say you’re here.
home.discoverBody: See everyday life in other classes, generations and places.
home.showingAnswers: Showing answers to this week’s question

weekly.label: This week’s question
weekly.optional: Optional. Answer whenever you like, or not at all.
